text: おねえちゃんと　いっしょ　じゃないと　やだな　ポケモン　２ひき　もってない？

structure.jp: おねえちゃんと　いっしょ　じゃないと
structure.en: if I'm not together with my big sister

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.span: いっしょ　じゃないと　やだな
patterns.explanation: A 'not' form followed by と means 'if not, then'. With やだ after it, it says the speaker won't accept anything else. いっしょ　じゃないと　やだな = 'I don't want to unless we're together'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: もってない is the shortened spoken form of もっていない. ている after a verb shows a lasting state, here having something on you. もってない？ = 'don't you have?'
